title: Does vesicle depletion make the twin's firing rate fall under GABA-A block, as real chips' does? (SIMULATED)
status: registered before any simulation of depression under a drug knob was run
origin: post-round-1 review: real GABA-A antagonist pairs lower mfr_hz and burst rates, the twin raises mfr_hz (report §14, HD13 'differ'); the review proposes that presynaptic vesicle depletion, absent from the calibrated twin, is the missing mechanism
seen_before_registration: HD18 (twin_hd18_depression): depression at the existing calibration, untreated only; no setting beat the control on the calibration score
HD13 (twin_hd13_perturbation): without depression, gabaa_scale 0.2 raises mfr_hz (simulated delta 2.706) where real GABA-A antagonist pairs lower it (median -0.335); 4 of 5 established features agree
real bicuculline dose trend (feature_dose_response): burst_rate_per_min and network_burst_rate_per_min fall with dose (Spearman -0.58, -0.60)

design.twin: the calibrated twin as HD13 runs it (calibrated parameters, same electrode layout and feature merge), recurrent excitatory synapses with Tsodyks-Markram depression
design.deltas: log2(treated / untreated) per feature with the HD13 rule (simulated_delta), seed-matched, then averaged over seeds
design.real_reference: real_directions() per mechanism, 1000 bootstrap resamples, seed 0, as HD13

qualifying_rule.i: mean delta log2 mfr_hz at gabaa_scale 0.2 is below 0
qualifying_rule.ii: Spearman(1 - gabaa_scale, feature) <= -0.5 for both burst_rate_per_min and network_burst_rate_per_min, over per-seed values at the five dose-series levels
qualifying_rule.iii: agreeing features summed over the four knobs >= the control setting's sum

V1_some_setting_qualifies.statement: At least one depression setting meets i, ii and iii

V2_the_control_does_not.statement: Without depression the twin fails i (it raises firing rate under block)

V3_the_chosen_setting_replicates.statement: The qualifying setting with the lowest untreated calibration score (the HD18 scorer) meets i and ii again on fresh seeds
V3_the_chosen_setting_replicates.test: i and ii hold on seeds 10-12; n/a if V1 fails

not_claimed_even_if_all_pass: that the real cultures deplete vesicles, or that the twin is recalibrated; the weights stay as calibrated without depression (the HD18 caveat), so a pass means the mechanism can produce the real direction, not that it does
reporting: Every prediction with its value and pass/fail, whichever way it falls.
